compared: HQ IMX477: optics depend on lens, cannot assert FOV without chosen lens
compared.initial_panorama_hypothesis: 180-degree opposed corridor pair evaluated as hypothesis, not represented as an ordinary perspective camera
compared.decision: Six conventional wide views selected provisionally: short overlapping baselines on both sides of the existing security partition and detailed kiosk views. Endpoint panoramas spread fixed pixels across walls/glass and cannot remove partition occlusion. Final coverage must pass rendered multi-view tests; not a claim of optimal hardware placement.
compared.fov_rectification: Datasheet raw H102/V67 differ slightly from a distortion-free 16:9 pinhole. Preserve V67 and explicitly derive rectified H from aspect; no false exact physical lens equivalence.
